Players Committee card image of [[Ahch-To: Saddle]] (the same image re-uploaded turned 90°; part of that version, not a separate one; no errata mark), printing: “'''Light Side:''' May ▼ [Episode VII] Luke here. Once per turn, if Luke alone here, may subtract 2 from opponent's total power during a battle at another location.” Uploaded unchanged.

Source: the Players Committee Holotable image set, file [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/c2afd5e/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual10-Light/large/ahchtosaddle.gif Images-HT/starwars/Virtual10-Light/large/ahchtosaddle.gif] as of commit c2afd5e “Flipped site images” (9 January 2019).
